name: Chickpea Shawarma Bowl
steps: Preheat oven to 220°C. Pat chickpeas dry; toss with oil, cumin, paprika, ground coriander, cinnamon and 3 g salt.
Spread on a baking tray and roast for 25 minutes, stirring halfway, until browned and lightly crisp outside.
Combine couscous with 1 g salt. Add 250 ml boiling water, cover for 8 minutes and fluff with a fork.
Whisk curd, tahini, lemon juice, crushed garlic, remaining 30 ml water and 2 g salt. Dice tomato and cucumber.
Divide couscous among 4 bowls; add roasted chickpeas and vegetables. Spoon over tahini-curd sauce and serve warm.
tips: Drying chickpeas helps the spices roast evenly instead of steaming.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
